Title: RL PARALLEL CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE
Trainers: 130A, 130E, TD2000
Quiz: Nos
The following experiments reinforce procedures used to troubleshoot RL parallel circuits. You will compare calculated values with measured circuit values to determine if a fault exists.
EXPERIMENT

Adjust the Function Generator output level for 5 Vrms as measured by an analog meter. If measuring with an oscilloscope adjust the Function Generator output for 5 Vpp. This is Ea, measured across TP10 and TP1.....
Throughout the rest of the lesson the discussion will refer to multimeter lead placement. If using an oscilloscope select the help button below.
